quick_start: twilio api:lookups:v2:phone-numbers:fetch --phone-number '+14155552671' --fields caller_name,line_type_intelligence

name: Awesome Telegram OSINT Toolkit Index
description: Community-maintained encyclopedia of Telegram OSINT tradecraft, numeric-ID tricks, group catalog search engines, archive scripts, and OPSEC pitfalls.
quick_start: Consult before running Telegram investigations to check current working web mirrors and MTProto changes.

name: DISBOARD
description: Largest public Discord server directory searchable by tag, language, and member count—useful for discovering community servers linked to niche topics or handles.
quick_start: Search tags and keywords on https://disboard.org/ and inspect invite JSON via `https://discord.com/api/v10/invites/<code>?with_counts=true`.

name: DiscordLeaks (Unicorn Riot)
description: Journalistic public-interest searchable archive of hundreds of thousands of chat messages from extremist and hate-group Discord servers published by Unicorn Riot.
quick_start: Search handles, Discord user IDs, or keywords across archived chat servers at https://discordleaks.unicornriot.ninja/.

name: ITU National Numbering Plans
description: Authoritative International Telecommunication Union allocation tables documenting mobile operator prefixes, geographic area codes, and special-service ranges for every country.
quick_start: Verify obscure international NDC/operator mobile block allocations directly from official ITU regulatory filings.

name: Lyzem
description: Privacy-friendly web search engine indexing public Telegram channels, groups, bots, and Telegraph (`telegra.ph`) articles by keyword.
quick_start: Include `telegra.ph` long-form manifestos/guides in keyword searches on https://lyzem.com/.

name: Numverify API
description: Global phone validation and carrier-lookup REST API covering 232 countries, returning real-time carrier name, location, and mobile vs. VoIP/landline classification.
quick_start: Integrate free-tier API key into PhoneInfoga or query `/api/validate?number=...` directly.

name: SearchPhone
description: Multi-API phone OSINT toolkit combining Numverify, Google/DuckDuckGo/Reddit/GitHub dorking, and Hudson Rock infostealer phone checks with automated HTML/JSON dossier generation.
quick_start: python3 searchphone.py +14155552671

name: SpyDialer
description: Free US reverse phone, name, address, and email lookup tool with public CNAM/directory correlation.
quick_start: Use Name Lookup mode (passive) at https://www.spydialer.com/; avoid Voicemail mode in covert cases (active call!).

name: TGScope
description: Catalog and search engine covering 3M+ public Telegram channels with topic/language filters and a channel/supergroup creation-date estimator from numeric IDs.
quick_start: Use TGScope's Channel Creation Date lookup to spot newly minted impersonation or scam channels.

name: WhatsApp Direct & Business Metadata (`wa.me`)
description: WhatsApp Business & profile reconnaissance via `https://wa.me/<E164_digits>` and WhatsApp Web inside an isolated burner environment—revealing profile photos, status timestamps, and Business catalog/addresses.
quick_start: Check WhatsApp registration first via Epieos, then inspect Business catalog/hours from a dedicated burner number with privacy settings locked.

name: CourtListener & RECAP Archive
description: Free Law Project's open legal archive containing millions of US federal PACER filings, judicial opinions, oral arguments, judge financial disclosures, and real-time docket alerts.
quick_start: Always search CourtListener's RECAP tab before paying per-page PACER fees; install the RECAP browser extension.

name: Judyrecords
description: Free full-text search engine indexing 760+ million US federal and state court cases, dockets, civil lawsuits, criminal filings, and small-claims records nationwide.
quick_start: Wrap full names or rare street addresses in quotes (`"John Q. Doe"`) on https://www.judyrecords.com/.

name: Lumen Database (Harvard Berkman Klein Center)
description: Collects millions of DMCA takedown, defamation, court-order, and reputation-management removal notices sent to Google, X, YouTube, and GitHub—frequently unmasking who hired PR firms to scrub links!
quick_start: When Google says 'Some results may have been removed', click the Lumen link or search https://lumendatabase.org/ for the exact removed URLs!

name: PACER (US Federal Courts)
description: Official US Judiciary portal providing authoritative access to federal appellate, district, and bankruptcy court dockets, indictments, civil complaints, and exhibits.
quick_start: Quarterly fees under $30 are waived automatically by the US Administrative Office of the Courts.

name: Worldwide OSINT Tools Map (cipher387)
description: Interactive world map plotting 600+ country-specific official databases—land cadastres, national business registers, court portals, license-plate checks, and voter/resident directories.
quick_start: Click any country pin on https://cipher387.github.io/osintmap/ to jump straight to local judicial/cadastral registries.

name: BAILII (British & Irish Legal Information Institute)
description: Primary free full-text database of British, Irish, Scottish, Northern Irish, European, and Privy Council court judgments and tribunal rulings.
quick_start: Search Privy Council decisions on BAILII to uncover appellate litigation from BVI, Cayman, and Bermuda offshore entities.

name: DOJ FARA eFile Search
description: US Department of Justice Foreign Agents Registration Act database containing unredacted contracts, wire amounts, PR retainers, and meeting logs between foreign principals and US lobbyists.
quick_start: Full-text search exhibit PDFs on https://efile.fara.gov/ for foreign ministries, sovereign funds, and PR firms.

name: FamilySearch
description: World's largest free genealogical archive indexing billions of digitized civil birth/marriage/death certificates, census rolls, immigration manifests, and naturalization records globally.
quick_start: Create a free research account to search unindexed municipal civil-registry microfilm scans worldwide.

name: FastPeopleSearch
description: Free US public-records aggregator linking full names, historical residential addresses, landline/wireless numbers, known relatives, and household associates.
quick_start: Accessible from US IP ranges; pivot across historical street addresses to confirm co-residents and associates.

name: FEC Individual Contributions Search
description: Official US Federal Election Commission database of itemized political contributions, exposing contributor full names, residential cities/ZIPs, employers, and job titles.
quick_start: Query target name or employer at https://www.fec.gov/data/receipts/individual-contributions/ for high-confidence employment verification.

name: FINRA BrokerCheck & SEC IAPD
description: Official regulatory background portal for US securities brokers, investment advisers, and firms—detailing 10-year employment histories, exams, customer disputes, and regulatory sanctions.
quick_start: Download full Detailed BrokerCheck PDF reports to inspect outside business activities (OBAs) and alias disclosures.

name: INTERPOL Red & Yellow Notices
description: Official INTERPOL public portal listing internationally wanted fugitives (Red Notices) and missing persons (Yellow Notices) filterable by nationality, age, name, and issuing country.
quick_start: Cross-check international KYC/due-diligence subjects against INTERPOL Red Notices (also indexed in OpenSanctions).

name: Justia Dockets & Filings
description: Free searchable index of US federal district and appellate court dockets filterable by party name, state, court, nature of suit, and filing date.
quick_start: Filter by Nature of Suit (e.g., Fraud, Trademark, RICO) alongside entity/person names at https://dockets.justia.com/.

name: LittleSis
description: Watchdog 'involuntary social network' database mapping board memberships, lobbying ties, campaign donations, family links, and revolving-door relationships among executives and public officials.
quick_start: Use LittleSis Oligograph tool to build annotated relationship maps of executives, foundations, and political donors.

name: Newspapers.com & Chronicling America (LOC)
description: Library of Congress (`chroniclingamerica.loc.gov`, free) and commercial regional newspaper OCR archives surfacing local arrest blotters, marriage announcements, property sales, and obituaries unindexed by Google.
quick_start: Search regional print newspapers by town + surname to uncover pre-internet court/police blotter items.

name: OpenSecrets
description: Nonpartisan research database tracking US federal campaign contributions, PACs, dark-money 501(c)(4) flows, FARA foreign-agent registrations, congressional stock trades, and lobbying disclosures.
quick_start: Search OpenSecrets Donor Lookup—itemized FEC filings frequently reveal a donor's exact employer, occupation, and ZIP/city!

name: OSINT-for-Countries Directory
description: Structured encyclopedia of local OSINT portals across all 193 UN member states and territories—covering ministries of justice, tax IDs, property records, procurement, and local search engines.
quick_start: Browse country markdown guides in `wddadk/OSINT-for-countries` when investigating unfamiliar jurisdictions.

name: Pipl
description: Enterprise identity-resolution platform linking billions of cross-referenced non-public/public identity attributes (names, handles, phones, career history, global addresses) for fraud and LE analysts.
quick_start: Enterprise subscription required; combine subtle partial selectors (e.g., handle + city) to disambiguate common names.

name: TruePeopleSearch
description: Free US people-search directory offering reverse name, reverse phone, and reverse street-address lookups with associated emails and relative trees.
quick_start: Cross-reference results between FastPeopleSearch and TruePeopleSearch to filter stale credit-header noise.

name: Ancestry
description: Commercial genealogical archive indexing US/UK/European city directories, high-school yearbooks, draft cards, marriage indexes, voters rolls, and user-uploaded family trees.
quick_start: US High School Yearbooks (1900–2016) on Ancestry often provide verified juvenile/young-adult facial photos and middle names.

name: ClustrMaps
description: Aggregates US municipal property deeds, neighborhood demographics, corporate officer filings, and resident histories by person name or street parcel.
quick_start: Search a US street address on https://clustrmaps.com/ to list historical residents and linked LLCs.

name: Europe's Most Wanted (Europol / ENFAST)
description: European Network of Fugitive Active Search Teams & Europol public fugitive portal listing high-priority European wanted suspects and crime summaries.
quick_start: Screen high-risk European KYC subjects against https://eumostwanted.eu/ and INTERPOL Red Notices.

name: FBI Wanted & Kidnappings API
description: Official FBI database and keyless public JSON API (`api.fbi.gov/wanted/v1/list`) covering cyber fugitives, transnational crime targets, terrorism suspects, and missing persons.
quick_start: curl -s 'https://api.fbi.gov/wanted/v1/list?field_offices=newyork' | jq '.items[].title'

name: Find a Grave
description: Crowdsourced global cemetery and obituary index listing 230M+ memorials, often containing full obituaries naming living spouses, children, siblings, and hometowns.
quick_start: Search deceased relatives' memorials to map living family trees and maiden names.

name: That'sThem
description: People and asset lookup portal supporting reverse address, reverse phone, reverse email, VIN, and IP-to-household correlation across US consumer datasets.
quick_start: Run free daily reverse-address or reverse-email queries at https://thatsthem.com/.

name: UK National Archives — Find Case Law
description: Official UK National Archives repository publishing High Court, Court of Appeal, Supreme Court, and Upper Tribunal judgments as structured XML/HTML.
quick_start: Search commercial court and freezing-order judgments at https://caselaw.nationalarchives.gov.uk/.

name: US Federal Bureau of Prisons (BOP) Locator
description: Official lookup of federal inmates incarcerated from 1982 to the present, including BOP register numbers, current facility, age, and projected/actual release dates.
quick_start: Query by first/last name or BOP Register Number at https://www.bop.gov/inmateloc/.

name: US NPPES NPI Registry (Healthcare Providers)
description: Official HHS/CMS database and free REST API of every licensed US physician, clinic, pharmacist, and healthcare provider with practice addresses, taxonomies, and phone numbers.
quick_start: curl -s 'https://npiregistry.cms.hhs.gov/api/?version=2.1&last_name=Smith&state=NY&limit=5' | jq

name: VINELink
description: US nationwide correctional custody and offender status lookup portal covering thousands of county jails and state Departments of Corrections.
quick_start: Select US state and search custody status by name/ID at https://vinelink.vineapps.com/.

name: DeHashed
description: High-speed breach correlation search engine and REST API for authorized security researchers, supporting regex/wildcard pivoting across emails, usernames, IPs, phones, VINs, and password hashes.
quick_start: Pivot from a breached email -> registration IP or password hash -> other accounts sharing that exact unique hash.

name: Distributed Denial of Secrets (DDoSecrets)
description: Non-profit journalist transparency collective curating and indexing terabytes of public-interest leaked corporate, government, financial, and oligarch document datasets.
quick_start: Search indexed public-interest datasets via DDoSecrets or OCCRP Aleph cross-listings.

name: Have I Been Pwned (HIBP)
description: Troy Hunt's gold-standard breach exposure service indexing 17.8B+ compromised accounts across 1,000+ breaches, stealer logs, and pastes—without ever exposing raw victim passwords.
quick_start: Check single emails free on web, verify owned domains for free org monitoring, or query Pwned Passwords via k-Anonymity SHA-1 prefix (`api.pwnedpasswords.com/range/5BAA6`).

name: Hudson Rock — Cavalier Free OSINT Tools
description: Global cybercrime intelligence engine fueled by millions of real-world RedLine, Lumma, Vidar, and Raccoon infostealer malware infections—checking compromised domains, emails, usernames, and IPs.
quick_start: curl -s 'https://cavalier.hudsonrock.com/api/json/v2/osint-tools/search-by-email?email=test@example.com' | jq

name: Intelligence X (IntelX)
description: Massive historical OSINT archive indexing 200B+ records across data leaks, Pastebin/paste sites, I2P/Tor darknets, WHOIS history, public documents, and DNS selectors.
quick_start: Search emails, domains, BTC addresses, or CIDRs on https://intelx.io/ (50 free metadata/preview searches/day).

name: RansomLook
description: 100% open-source ransomware intelligence platform scraping, screenshotting, and indexing 100+ ransomware extortion `.onion` leak portals, Telegram channels, and victim posts on the clearnet.
quick_start: curl -s https://www.ransomlook.io/api/recent | jq  # Query ransomware victims without touching Tor

name: LeakCheck
description: Breach search engine indexing 7.5B+ records across 3,000+ leaked databases and stealer logs, searchable by email, username, corporate domain, phone, or keyword.
quick_start: pip install leakcheck && leakcheck-cli lookup user@example.com

name: LeakIX
description: Continuous internet-wide indexer flagging misconfigured open databases (Elastic, Mongo, CouchDB, Redis), exposed `.git`/`.env` files, and vulnerable web services with responsible disclosure focus.
quick_start: Search `+domain:"example.com"` or `+plugin:GitConfigHttpPlugin` passively on https://leakix.net/.

name: Psbdmp
description: Searchable archive of millions of scraped Pastebin dumps with a free REST API for hunting leaked emails, domains, configs, and dox pastes that were later deleted from Pastebin.
quick_start: curl -s 'https://psbdmp.ws/api/v3/search/example.com' | jq

name: Pwned Passwords k-Anonymity API
description: Keyless, zero-knowledge SHA-1/NTLM hash range API (`api.pwnedpasswords.com/range/<5-hex>`) checking 900M+ real-world leaked passwords without ever transmitting the full hash over the network!
quick_start: SHA1=$(printf 'password123' | sha1sum | awk '{print toupper($1)}'); curl -s https://api.pwnedpasswords.com/range/${SHA1:0:5} | grep ${SHA1:5}

name: ransomwatch
description: Open-source tracker monitoring ransomware gang darknet leak sites and publishing machine-readable JSON feeds of active extortion groups, onion mirror uptime, and claimed victims.
quick_start: curl -s https://raw.githubusercontent.com/joshhighet/ransomwatch/main/posts.json | jq '.[-5:]'

name: SEC Item 1.05 Material Cybersecurity Incident Filings
description: Public companies traded in the US must disclose material cybersecurity breaches on Form 8-K Item 1.05 within 4 business days—providing authoritative primary-source incident intelligence.
quick_start: Search `"Item 1.05"` on SEC EDGAR Full-Text Search (`sec.gov/edgar/search/`) filtered to Form `8-K`.

name: SOCRadar Free SOC Tools
description: Suite of free external threat intelligence utilities including Dark Web Report, Stealer Log Domain Check, Phishing Radar, and External Attack Surface Mapper.
quick_start: Run Account Breach & Dark Web Radar on a target corporate domain at https://socradar.io/labs/.

name: SpyCloud Cybercrime Exposure Check
description: Enterprise infostealer and recaptured darknet credential intelligence vendor offering free domain-level exposure statistics (infected employees, infected consumers, reused passwords).
quick_start: Enter any corporate domain on SpyCloud's free exposure checker to gauge recent stealer-log volume.

name: State AG Official Data Breach Portals (CA / ME / HHS OCR)
description: Mandatory government breach notification registries (California OAG, Maine AG—shows exact victim headcount & attack vector!, and US HHS OCR 'Wall of Shame' healthcare breaches) with official notification letters!
quick_start: Search Maine AG (`apps.web.maine.gov/online/aeviewer/ME/40/list.shtml`) & CA OAG to get exact incident dates and forensic breach PDFs!

name: WikiLeaks Public Library of US Diplomacy & Leaks
description: Full-text diplomatic cable and historical leak search engine spanning PlusD diplomatic cables, Syria/HackingTeam/Sony/Vault7 archives, and defense procurement documents.
quick_start: Use `search.wikileaks.org/advanced` filtered by dataset and date range for historical corporate/political vetting.

name: BreachDirectory
description: Public breach search engine revealing redacted password prefixes and SHA-1 hashes tied to compromised emails and usernames to verify identity continuity across sites.
quick_start: Compare SHA-1 hash fingerprints across multiple handles to test whether the same person registered both accounts.

name: Constella Intelligence
description: Enterprise digital-risk and identity-breach lake indexing 100B+ breach attributes for executive protection, fraud attribution, and law-enforcement correlation.
quick_start: Used by enterprise CTI and financial-crime units for historical selector linking.

name: Cryptome
description: Long-running open-source archive of declassified intelligence manuals, court exhibits, FOIA disclosures, satellite imagery guides, and telecommunications filings since 1996.
quick_start: Search `site:cryptome.org <topic>` via Google or DuckDuckGo for primary government/telecom documents.

name: Mozilla Monitor
description: Open-source personal data-broker and breach exposure checker backed by HIBP and US data-broker scan coverage for defensive self-OSINT audits.
quick_start: Audit executive/investigator exposure on data-broker sites and breaches at https://monitor.mozilla.org/.

name: pwnedOrNot
description: Python OSINT CLI checking email breach metadata via HaveIBeenPwned v3 and hunting corresponding public Pastebin dumps.
quick_start: python3 pwnedornot.py -e target@example.com

name: Snusbase
description: Indexed breach lookup service allowing investigators to pivot across emails, usernames, real names, registration IPs, and hashed/unhashed credentials.
quick_start: Integrate API key with h8mail or query JSON endpoints for automated incident-response triage.

name: WhatBreach
description: Python OSINT CLI correlating breached email addresses against HIBP, BreachDirectory/DeHashed metadata, and Pastebin dumps in batch mode.
quick_start: python3 whatbreach.py -e target@example.com

name: BuiltWith
description: Profiles 100,000+ web technologies AND tracks shared Google Analytics, Tag Manager, AdSense, Facebook Pixel, and Cloudflare IDs across historical crawls to link covert sister sites.
quick_start: Open the 'Relationships' tab (`builtwith.com/relationships/example.com`) to reveal hidden sites sharing analytics/pixel IDs!

name: crt.sh (Certificate Transparency Search)
description: Sectigo's free, keyless Certificate Transparency log search engine with direct public PostgreSQL SQL access (`crt.sh:5432`)—exposing every publicly trusted SSL/TLS cert and SAN subdomain ever issued.
quick_start: curl -s 'https://crt.sh/?q=%25.example.com&output=json' | jq -r '.[].name_value' | sort -u

name: DNSDumpster
description: HackerTarget's free domain reconnaissance portal mapping MX, NS, TXT, A records, netblock owners, open banners, and auto-generated network topology graphs.
quick_start: Query any domain on https://dnsdumpster.com/ and download the XLSX host spreadsheet and PNG topology map.

name: dnstwist
description: Domain permutation engine detecting homograph attacks, typosquatting, bitsquatting, and brand-impersonation phishing domains with MX/A resolution, GeoIP, and visual/fuzzy pHash web page comparison.
quick_start: dnstwist --registered --whois --lsh https://example.com  # Web version: https://dnstwister.report

name: httpx (ProjectDiscovery)
description: Fast multi-purpose Go HTTP toolkit probing discovered hosts for status codes, HTML titles, TLS certs, JARM hashes, favicon `mmh3` hashes, tech stacks, ASN info, and CDN detection.
quick_start: cat subs.txt | httpx -title -tech-detect -status-code -favicon -jarm -asn -json -o live.json

name: ICANN Centralized Zone Data Service (CZDS)
description: Official free ICANN portal allowing researchers to request and download complete daily authoritative DNS zone files (`.com`, `.net`, `.org`, and 1,100+ gTLDs)—every active domain name on Earth!
quick_start: Apply free at https://czds.icann.org/ to `ripgrep` raw daily TLD zone files locally for brand/keyword monitoring with zero API fees!

name: OWASP Amass
description: Flagship OWASP external attack-surface mapping engine combining 50+ passive DNS/CT/ASN/archive sources, BGP netblock expansion, and Open Asset Model graph storage.
quick_start: amass enum -passive -d example.com  # Always pass -passive for zero target interaction

name: SecurityTrails
description: Premier historical DNS and WHOIS time-machine tracking multi-year A, AAAA, MX, NS, and TXT record changes—essential for unmasking pre-Cloudflare origin server IPs.
quick_start: Inspect Historical A Records on SecurityTrails to locate the origin IP before a domain migrated behind a CDN.

name: Subfinder
description: ProjectDiscovery's ultra-fast passive subdomain enumeration Go CLI querying 40+ passive certificate, DNS, archive, and threat-intel sources in seconds without touching target DNS.
quick_start: subfinder -d example.com -all -silent -o subs.txt

name: waymore
description: Downloads archived URLs AND actual historical HTTP responses for a domain across Wayback Machine, Common Crawl, AlienVault OTX, URLScan, and VirusTotal simultaneously.
quick_start: pipx install waymore && waymore -i example.com -mode U  # Passive URL extraction across 5 archives

name: Whoxy
description: High-value historical WHOIS and Reverse WHOIS API/search engine indexing pre-GDPR registrant names, emails, company strings, and 20+ years of domain ownership changes.
quick_start: Run Reverse WHOIS by email or company name at https://www.whoxy.com/ to uncover every domain registered by the same actor.

name: assetfinder
description: TomNomNom's minimalist, lightning-fast Go binary querying crt.sh, CertSpotter, HackerTarget, ThreatMiner, Wayback, and Facebook CT logs for related domains and subdomains.
quick_start: assetfinder --subs-only example.com | sort -u

name: Cert Spotter
description: Open-source Go daemon and SSLMate API monitoring Certificate Transparency logs in real time for unauthorized certificates, shadow IT subdomains, and phishing clones.
quick_start: curl -s 'https://api.certspotter.com/v1/issuances?domain=example.com&include_subdomains=true&expand=dns_names' | jq

name: DNSlytics
description: Domain, IP, ASN, and reverse-tracker intelligence engine supporting Reverse Analytics, Reverse AdSense, Reverse NS/MX, and SPF domain relationship mapping.
quick_start: Pivot on SPF `include:` mechanisms and shared nameservers via https://dnslytics.com/.

name: dnsx (ProjectDiscovery)
description: High-speed Go multi-purpose DNS toolkit querying A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, NS, TXT, SOA, PTR, and ASN data with wildcard filtering across millions of subdomains.
quick_start: cat subs.txt | dnsx -a -cname -resp -silent

name: DomainTools Iris
description: Enterprise domain intelligence standard offering 20+ years of WHOIS snapshots, Passive DNS, domain risk scoring, and multi-hop infrastructure pivot graphs for CTI teams.
quick_start: Pivot across shared SSL hashes, registrant emails, and nameserver clusters inside DomainTools Iris.

name: Findomain
description: Blazing-fast Rust subdomain recognition engine supporting passive API aggregation, continuous monitoring, headless screenshots, HTTP probing, and Discord/Slack/Telegram new-asset alerts.
quick_start: findomain -t example.com -q

name: gau (GetAllUrls)
description: Fetches known historical URLs for any domain from AlienVault's Open Threat Exchange, the Wayback Machine, Common Crawl, and URLScan without touching the target.
quick_start: echo example.com | gau --subs | sort -u > historical_urls.txt

name: hakrawler
description: Simple, fast Go CLI web crawler designed for chaining in Unix pipelines (`echo https://example.com | hakrawler`) to discover JS endpoints, subdomains, and forms.
quick_start: echo https://example.com | hakrawler -subs -u

name: ICANN Lookup (Official RDAP)
description: Authoritative Registration Data Access Protocol (RDAP) client querying gTLD registries directly for registrar IANA IDs, registry lock status, creation/expiry timestamps, and nameservers.
quick_start: Query https://lookup.icann.org/ or raw JSON RDAP (`https://rdap.org/domain/example.com`).

name: Katana
description: Next-generation Go web crawling and spidering framework supporting both standard HTTP and headless Chromium JS rendering to extract hidden API routes, JS files, and forms.
quick_start: katana -u https://example.com -jc -kf all -silent

name: Nuclei (Exposure & OSINT Templates)
description: YAML template-driven scanner featuring dedicated `osint/`, `exposures/`, `token-spray/`, and `technologies/` template suites ( ONLY run active probes against explicitly authorized targets!).
quick_start: nuclei -t http/osint/ -var user=target_handle  # Built-in 700+ OSINT username templates!

name: OneForAll
description: Comprehensive Python subdomain collection framework integrating certificate logs, passive DNS datasets, search engines, ASN lookups, and subdomain takeover checks.
quick_start: python3 oneforall.py --target example.com run

name: openSquat
description: Monitors newly registered domains (NRDs) daily against brand keywords using Levenshtein distance, homoglyphs, Certificate Transparency streams, and PhishTank checks.
quick_start: python3 opensquat.py -k keywords.txt --ct

name: ParamSpider
description: Mines URL query parameters (`?id=`, `?redirect=`, `?file=`) from dark corners of Web Archives passively without sending fuzzing traffic to the target server.
quick_start: paramspider -d example.com

name: ProjectDiscovery Chaos Public Bug-Bounty Dataset
description: Continuously updated passive DNS and subdomain dataset covering thousands of major global technology, finance, and enterprise programs with instant ZIP downloads and Go CLI.
quick_start: chaos -d example.com -silent

name: RapidDNS
description: Fast, completely free, keyless web and API passive DNS lookup returning subdomains (`rapiddns.io/subdomain/example.com`) and same-IP virtual hosts (`rapiddns.io/sameip/<IP>`).
quick_start: curl -s 'https://rapiddns.io/subdomain/example.com?full=1' | grep -oE '[a-zA-Z0-9._-]+\.example\.com' | sort -u

name: tlsx (ProjectDiscovery)
description: Fast TLS connection grabber extracting SAN/CN domain lists, JARM hashes, JA3 fingerprints, certificate serials, and expired/mismatched origin certificates across CIDR blocks.
quick_start: echo 198.51.100.0/24 | tlsx -san -cn -silent  # Reveals virtual-host domains bound to raw IPs!

name: ViewDNS.info
description: Swiss-army web toolkit bundling 20+ domain/IP utilities: Reverse IP Lookup, Reverse WHOIS, IP History,Reverse MX/NS, Chinese Firewall Test, DNSSEC check, and ASN lookup.
quick_start: Use ViewDNS IP History (`viewdns.info/iphistory/`) as a fast keyless check for historical origin IPs.

name: Wappalyzer
description: Browser extension and technographic lookup identifying CMS platforms, JS frameworks, WAFs, CDNs, analytics trackers, payment processors, and server headers on any webpage.
quick_start: Install Wappalyzer in your investigation browser to fingerprint web stacks passively as you browse.

name: waybackurls
description: Classic Unix-pipe Go CLI fetching historical URL snapshots from Wayback Machine, Common Crawl, and VirusTotal for any line-delimited list of domains.
quick_start: cat domains.txt | waybackurls | grep -E '\.(json|xml|conf|bak|env|pdf)$'

name: Cariddi
description: Go crawler taking lists of domains/URLs to hunt API endpoints, exposed secrets/keys, backup extensions, and error disclosures.
quick_start: cat urls.txt | cariddi -s -e

name: CompleteDNS (Historical Nameserver Changes)
description: Tracks multi-year authoritative `NS` nameserver history for domains—helpful for spotting when a domain switched from registrar parking to Cloudflare or bulletproof hosting.
quick_start: Inspect historical NS transitions to date exact domain ownership handovers.

name: digga
description: Browser and CLI domain research toolkit combining DNS, RDAP, WHOIS, passive subdomain discovery, IP/ASN enrichment, SPF/DMARC checks, and TLS inspection with no signup.
quick_start: Run quick domain diagnostics via digga for unified RDAP, DNS, email-auth, and TLS chain output.

name: DNSViz
description: Visualizes DNS delegation hierarchies, authoritative nameserver glue records, and full DNSSEC chain-of-trust cryptographic signatures from the root zone down.
quick_start: Analyze complex zone delegations and DNSSEC misconfigurations visually at https://dnsviz.net/.

name: DomainBigData
description: Free historical WHOIS, registrant name, registrant email, and same-IP correlation portal useful for unmasking pre-redaction legacy domain portfolios.
quick_start: Query registrant emails or legacy personal domains on https://domainbigdata.com/.

name: Robtex
description: Veteran passive DNS, BGP route, Autonomous System, and shared-host relationship grapher visualizing forward and reverse DNS links.

name: NASA Worldview
description: Interactive browser over 1,200+ daily global NASA satellite imagery layers—many updated within 3 hours of overpass—for smoke plumes, cloud cover verification, floods, and night-lights blackouts.
quick_start: Compare historical cloud cover on NASA Worldview to verify whether a claimed outdoor photo matches that day's sky!

name: Overpass Turbo (OpenStreetMap Query Engine)
description: The single most powerful deterministic photo-geolocation tool: executes spatial queries against OpenStreetMap's global vector database to find exact geometric arrangements of roads, towers, bridges, and shops.
quick_start: Chain `around:100` filters in Overpass QL to find e.g. every school within 100m of both a water tower and railway line!

name: QGIS
description: World's flagship open-source Geographic Information System desktop workstation for fusing Sentinel/Maxar GeoTIFF rasters, Overpass GeoJSON layers, AIS/ADS-B tracks, and visibility viewsheds.
quick_start: Install QuickMapServices + QuickOSM + Lat Lon Tools plugins in QGIS for rapid OSINT basemap and vector fusion.

name: SunCalc
description: Computes solar azimuth, altitude angle, shadow length ratios, dawn/dusk twilight phases, and sun trajectory arcs for any coordinate and date/time on Earth.
quick_start: Enter object height in SunCalc's top-left panel and match the orange shadow-direction vector against shadows in a photo.

name: Wolfram|Alpha Historical Weather & Astronomy
description: Queries historical airport METAR weather stations worldwide for exact temperature, cloud cover, wind speed, precipitation, moon phase, and twilight at any city and historic date/hour!
quick_start: Query `weather in Kyiv on March 14, 2025 at 14:00` on https://www.wolframalpha.com/ to verify rain/snow/cloud claims in videos!

name: Yandex Maps & Street Panoramas
description: Essential satellite, business directory, and street-level panorama map covering Russia, Ukraine, Central Asia, Caucasus, Turkey, and MENA—often featuring higher-res local aerials than Google.
quick_start: Compare Yandex satellite & Mirror/Panorama layers when Google blurs or outdatedly renders Eurasian/MENA sites.

name: Baidu Maps & Total View
description: Primary street-view ('Total View'), 3D building footprint, and POI directory for mainland China—note China uses GCJ-02 / BD-09 coordinate offsets relative to WGS-84 GPS!
quick_start: Convert BD-09 coordinates back to WGS-84 before plotting Baidu Map pins into Google Earth or QGIS!

name: DeepStateMAP
description: Geolocated open-source conflict control-line map featuring historical daily timeline sliders, ruler/azimuth tools, FIRMS fire overlays, and verified incident citations.
quick_start: Scrub the calendar control on https://deepstatemap.live/ to verify territorial status on any historical date.

name: earth.nullschool.net (Global Wind, Ocean & Smoke)
description: Interactive 3D globe visualizing historical and live global GFS wind vectors, ocean currents, particulate smoke (`PM2.5`/`SO2`/`CO`), and wave heights—vital for verifying smoke drift direction in strike videos!
quick_start: Click 'earth' bottom-left -> adjust UTC date/hour -> compare wind vector azimuth against smoke plume direction in video!

name: GeoHints
description: Visual reference encyclopedia cataloging country-specific roadside bollards, utility poles, guardrails, road markings, pedestrian signs, mailboxes, and license plates.
quick_start: Match unknown roadside bollards, chevrons, or utility poles on https://geohints.com/ to narrow down the country in seconds.

name: Global Forest Watch
description: World Resources Institute satellite monitoring platform offering weekly radar/optical deforestation alerts (`GLAD`/`RADD`)—used in OSINT to spot illegal mining airstrips, logging roads, and jungle camps.
quick_start: Enable Sentinel-1 RADD radar disturbance alerts on Global Forest Watch to detect new clearings under tropical cloud cover!

name: God's Eye View
description: Open-source photorealistic 3D browser spatial-intelligence globe fusing live ADS-B aircraft, CelesTrak orbital satellites, traffic cameras, and Cesium 3D tiles into one real-time tactical view.
quick_start: Clone `bilawalsidhu/gods-eye-view`, configure Cesium/Google 3D Tiles key, and launch local spatial fusion view.

name: KartaView
description: Open-licensed crowdsourced street-level photo platform (maintained by Grab/OSM community) providing dense ground-level street sequences especially across Southeast Asia, Eastern Europe, and Latin America.
quick_start: Check https://kartaview.org/ alongside Mapillary, Yandex Panorama, and Baidu Street View when Google coverage is blank.

name: Liveuamap
description: Near-real-time geolocated conflict, disaster, and security-incident map across 30+ regional theaters with historical date-picker playback back to 2014.
quick_start: Use the top-bar calendar widget on https://liveuamap.com/ to reconstruct chronological incident timelines on a specific date.

name: MapChecking (Crowd Size Estimator)
description: Fact-checking calculator estimating realistic protest, rally, or stadium crowd headcounts by drawing the occupied street polygon and testing density sliders (0.5 to 4 people/m²).
quick_start: Draw the crowd boundary observed in aerial/rooftop photos on https://www.mapchecking.com/ to debunk inflated attendance claims.

name: Maxar Open Data Program
description: Publishes free 30cm–50cm ultra-high-resolution pre- and post-event commercial satellite GeoTIFFs under Creative Commons for major earthquakes, floods, wildfires, and humanitarian crises.
quick_start: Browse Maxar's public AWS S3 STAC catalog via QGIS or Leafmap (`aws s3 ls s3://maxar-opendata/ --no-sign-request`).

name: OpenAerialMap
description: Open Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team repository of centimeter-resolution openly licensed drone/UAV orthomosaics and post-disaster aerial captures worldwide.
quick_start: Check https://map.openaerialmap.org/ for ultra-sharp UAV imagery over disaster/urban zones.

name: Overpass Ultra
description: Modern MapLibre GL vector-rendered successor to Overpass Turbo handling massive multi-thousand-feature spatial queries smoothly in browser WebGL.
quick_start: Use https://overpass-ultra.us/ when standard Overpass Turbo chokes on country-scale OpenStreetMap result sets.

name: PeakVisor / PeakFinder
description: Generates synthetic 360-degree mountain horizon skylines from global digital elevation models (DEMs) at any coordinate and elevation—allowing investigators to triangulate rural photos from distant ridgelines.
quick_start: Match distant mountain silhouettes on https://www.peakfinder.com/ to lock down exact camera azimuth and valley position.

name: Picarta.ai
description: Deep-learning visual photo geolocation platform and Python SDK predicting top GPS coordinate candidates worldwide from architecture, flora, soil, and signage when EXIF is stripped.
quick_start: Upload cropped exterior scenery (masking faces) to https://picarta.ai/ to generate regional candidate pins, then verify in OSM/Earth.

name: Plonk It Guide
description: Deep country-by-country and sub-regional visual recognition manual detailing regional architecture, phone area codes, vegetation, soil color, and camera-generation clues across 130+ countries.
quick_start: Use Plonk It's sub-regional maps (e.g., Brazil, Russia, Indonesia, Mexico state clues) after identifying the country.

name: Satellites.pro
description: Instant one-click basemap switcher comparing Apple Maps Satellite (often sharper & fresher than Google in Europe/MENA!), Google, Esri, Yandex, Mapbox, and OpenStreetMap at identical coordinates.
quick_start: Always check the 'Apple Satellite' layer on https://satellites.pro/—Apple often captures different months/angles than Google!

name: Shadowmap
description: Interactive global 3D building and terrain sunlight/shadow simulator rendering real-world cast shadows across urban canyons and mountains for any date and minute of the year.
quick_start: Scrub the time slider on https://app.shadowmap.org/ to match building facade shadows in urban videos.

name: SkyFi
description: Self-serve commercial satellite marketplace allowing individual researchers to buy archive scenes or task new 15cm–50cm optical, SAR, and thermal captures on demand without enterprise contracts.
quick_start: Use SkyFi Explore & free low-res previews to check exact commercial satellite pass dates over an AOI.

name: USGS EarthExplorer
description: US Geological Survey archive granting free downloads of 50+ years of Landsat multispectral scenes, NAIP aerial photography, SRTM digital elevation models, and declassified Cold War CORONA/KH-9 spy-sat photos.
quick_start: Draw a polygon on https://earthexplorer.usgs.gov/ to pull Landsat 8/9 scenes or declassified KH-9 Hexagon imagery.

name: Wikimapia
description: 20-year crowdsourced polygon annotation layer naming obscure industrial complexes, military depots, training ranges, mines, compounds, and local neighborhoods worldwide.
quick_start: Inspect polygon revision history and multilingual comments on https://wikimapia.org/ to identify unnamed facilities.

name: Zoom Earth
description: Near-real-time geostationary weather satellite imagery (GOES/Himawari/Meteosat every 10–15 minutes!), active wildfire hotspots, storm tracks, and historical cloud-cover playback.
quick_start: Verify exact cloud formations and smoke plume wind drift at 15-minute intervals on https://zoom.earth/!

name: Sightline (OSM Infrastructure Search)
description: Open-source OSINT search engine for mapping and querying real-world physical infrastructure (substations, telecom towers, pipelines, airfields, ports) extracted from OpenStreetMap.
quick_start: Clone `ni5arga/sightline` for rapid critical-infrastructure geospatial filtering.

name: ExifTool
description: Phil Harvey's legendary Perl CLI/library reading, writing, and auditing EXIF, GPS, XMP, IPTC, ICC, QuickTime atoms, PDF producer tags, and Office revision metadata across 400+ file formats.
quick_start: exiftool -a -u -g1 -ee -c '%.6f' suspect_media.mp4  # -ee extracts embedded GPS tracks from action-cam/drone videos!

name: FFmpeg
description: Universal open-source audio/video Swiss-army knife used in OSINT to dump lossless keyframes, stabilize shaky eyewitness clips (`vidstab`), isolate background audio, and inspect stream headers (`ffprobe`).
quick_start: ffmpeg -i clip.mp4 -vf "select='eq(pict_type,PICT_TYPE_I)'" -vsync vfr frame_%04d.png

name: Forensically (29a.ch)
description: Client-side HTML5 digital photo forensics laboratory offering Clone Detection (copy-move), Error Level Analysis (ELA), Noise Analysis, PCA, JPEG Ghost detection, and hidden thumbnail extraction.
quick_start: Runs 100% locally in browser RAM (images are never uploaded!); always check the 'Meta Data -> Thumbnail' tab for uncropped originals!

name: Google Lens
description: Multimodal visual recognition engine excelling at Exact Source ('Find image source') discovery, commercial product/clothing/weapon identification, sign OCR translation, and plant/species matching.
quick_start: Click 'Exact matches' tab in Google Lens to locate the earliest dated appearance of a recycled crisis photo.

name: InVID / WeVerify Verification Plugin
description: AFP Medialab / vera.ai browser workbench extracting video keyframes, running multi-engine reverse image searches, inspecting optical magnifiers, and running ELA/Ghost/Block forensic splicing filters.
quick_start: Open the InVID Toolbox tab -> Keyframes -> paste a video URL -> right-click extracted scene frames to search Yandex/Lens/TinEye.

name: PimEyes
description: High-recall commercial reverse facial-recognition engine indexing faces across news sites, blogs, company rosters, event galleries, and public web media (excludes major walled social networks).
quick_start: Use clear, front-facing, well-lit crops; review legal/GDPR rules in your jurisdiction before running biometric searches.

name: Search by Image (Browser Extension)
description: Open-source browser extension launching right-click reverse image lookups simultaneously across 30+ engines (Google Lens, Yandex, Bing, TinEye, Baidu, Sogou, SauceNAO, KarmaDecay, Alamy).
quick_start: Right-click any image or select screen region -> Search by Image -> All Engines.

name: TinEye
description: Dedicated perceptual-hash reverse image search indexing 70B+ web images with 'Oldest' sort ordering—the gold standard for debunking old stock/conflict photos reposted as breaking news.
quick_start: Sort TinEye results by 'Oldest' to immediately prove whether an image predates the claimed event.

name: Yandex Reverse Image Search
description: Consistently outperforms Western visual search engines on architectural landmarks, background scenery cropping, Cyrillic/Eurasian web sources, and same-person visual similarity matching.
quick_start: Use Yandex's interactive crop box around a single building, bridge, or uniform patch while excluding foreground people!

name: yt-dlp
description: De facto open-source media archiver supporting 1,800+ video/social platforms (YouTube, X, TikTok, Rumble, Telegram,VK, news sites) with `--write-info-json` forensic metadata sidecars.
quick_start: yt-dlp --write-info-json --write-subs --write-thumbnail -o '%(extractor)s_%(id)s.%(ext)s' '<URL>'

name: Baidu Image Search (`image.baidu.com`)
description: Mandatory reverse image engine when tracing images originating on Chinese platforms (Weibo, WeChat articles, Xiaohongshu/RED, Bilibili, Douyin, Taobao/1688 manufacturing catalogs).
quick_start: Click the camera icon on https://image.baidu.com/ to match hardware/equipment photos directly to Chinese OEM catalogs!

name: Bing Visual Search
description: Microsoft's visual object-crop and reverse image search engine—frequently surfaces distinct corporate PDFs, Pinterest boards, and news wire matches missed by Google Lens.
quick_start: Always run Google Lens + Yandex + Bing Visual Search + TinEye as a mandatory 4-engine quad check.

name: BirdNET Analyzer
description: Cornell Lab of Ornithology neural classifier identifying 6,000+ global bird species from faint background chirps in outdoor videos—narrowing down continent, biome, and migratory season!
quick_start: Extract background audio (`ffmpeg -i video.mp4 -vn audio.wav`) and analyze species range maps via BirdNET!

name: FaceCheck.ID
description: Investigative facial-recognition search engine indexing social media avatars, mugshots, news videos, podcasts, and scammer warnings.
quick_start: Test multiple angles of a subject's face to cross-match avatars across video and social platforms.

name: Hugin Panorama Stitcher
description: Open-source photogrammetry stitcher used by Bellingcat and visual-investigations teams to stitch panning handheld video frames into one wide-angle composite panorama for architectural geolocation.
quick_start: Extract 10–20 overlapping frames from a panning video with FFmpeg, then stitch into a single streetscape in Hugin.

name: Open Source Munitions Portal & ARES
description: Bellingcat & Fenix Insight visual identification catalog of military ordnance, cluster submunitions, tailfins, fuzes, stencil markings, and factory lot codes documented in open-source imagery.
quick_start: Match stenciled Cyrillic/Latin lot codes, fin geometries, and color bands safely via https://munitionsportal.org/.

name: SauceNAO
description: Specialized reverse image search indexing billions of digital illustrations, anime/manga avatars, Pixiv/DeviantArt/ArtStation/FurAffinity/Twitter artworks—crucial for attributing custom online avatars!
quick_start: When a threat actor uses a drawn/stylized avatar, run it on https://saucenao.com/—sometimes the actor commissioned or drew it themselves!

name: Search4Faces
description: Free facial-recognition search engine indexing over 1+ billion avatars across VKontakte, Odnoklassniki, TikTok, and Clubhouse profiles.
quick_start: Select the VK or TikTok avatar index on https://search4faces.com/ and optionally filter by age/city.

name: Sonic Visualiser / Audacity Spectrogram Forensics
description: Open-source precision audio spectrogram and waveform inspection workstation for analyzing gunshot acoustics (muzzle blast vs supersonic crack distance!), audio splice cuts, and 50Hz/60Hz mains hum (ENF).
quick_start: Inspect 50 Hz (Europe/Asia/Africa) vs 60 Hz (Americas/parts of Japan/Korea) electrical mains hum and acoustic lag in Sonic Visualiser!

name: TrueMedia.org Deepfake Detector
description: Non-partisan ensemble AI media-authentication platform testing suspect political/news videos, audio clips, and portraits across multiple academic synthetic-media detectors simultaneously.
quick_start: Always pair automated AI detector scores with provenance checks (TinEye/Wayback) and physical lighting/shadow geometry.

name: Aperi'Solve
description: Open-source multi-layer image inspection platform running ExifTool, `zsteg`, `steghide`, `outguess`, `binwalk`, `foremost`, `strings`, and RGB bit-plane decomposition in one view.
quick_start: Self-host via Docker for sensitive images or inspect non-sensitive files on https://www.aperisolve.com/.

name: FotoForensics
description: Dr. Neal Krawetz's pioneering Error Level Analysis (ELA), JPEG quantization-table camera-model fingerprinting, and metadata tutorial & analysis portal (note: uploads become public URLs!).
quick_start: Use FotoForensics only on public URLs; use client-side `29a.ch` Forensically for sensitive/unpublished photos!

name: Hiya AI Voice & Audio Deepfake Detector
description: Browser extension and audio authenticity verifier analyzing live web audio/video speeches, voicemails, and leaked recordings for ElevenLabs/TTS synthetic voice-cloning artifacts.
quick_start: Sample clean 10+ second speech segments free of heavy background music for accurate synthetic-voice scoring.

name: Jimpl Online EXIF & GPS Viewer
description: Clean, no-install web EXIF/IPTC/XMP metadata inspector plotting embedded GPS coordinates on a map (use local `exiftool` or `Forensically` instead if the image is confidential!).
quick_start: Use only on already-public images; for confidential evidence always run `exiftool` locally.

name: ADS-B Exchange
description: World's largest unfiltered public ADS-B and MLAT aircraft tracking map—refusing FAA LADD/PIA censorship blocks so investigators can track military transports, state VIP jets, and private tail numbers.
quick_start: Press `U` on https://globe.adsbexchange.com/ to filter strictly to Military aircraft, or click History to replay UTC dates!

name: airplanes.live
description: Community-owned, non-commercial, completely uncensored global ADS-B/MLAT flight tracker built by feeder volunteers displaying military, government, LADD, and private jets for free.
quick_start: Query ICAO 24-bit hex (`?icao=ae01d5`) on https://globe.airplanes.live/ and cross-compare feeder coverage with ADS-B Exchange.

name: Equasis
description: International public-safety maritime database (founded by EC & French Maritime Admin) providing free historical Registered Owner, Commercial Operator, ISM Manager, Flag, Class, P&I Club, and PSC inspection records by IMO!
quick_start: Free registration at https://www.equasis.org/—the single best free source for historical tanker/cargo management & insurer chains!

name: Flightradar24
description: Highest-density global commercial ADS-B, satellite ADS-B, and FLARM flight tracker offering 3D cockpit replay, weather overlays, airport ground movement, and granular fleet histories.
quick_start: Use Playback on https://www.flightradar24.com/ for commercial diversions and ground taxi timelines (note: honors FAA LADD blocks).

name: Global Fishing Watch Map
description: Open-access maritime transparency platform fusing commercial satellite AIS, VMS, Sentinel-1 SAR dark-vessel detections, Sentinel-2 optical imagery, loitering events, and ship-to-ship (STS) encounters!
quick_start: Create a free account on https://globalfishingwatch.org/map and enable 'SAR Vessel Detections' + 'Encounter Events' layers!

name: GPSJAM
description: Daily global H3 hexagonal map created by John Wiseman deriving real-world GPS/GNSS electronic-warfare jamming and spoofing zones from aircraft ADS-B navigation-accuracy (`NACp`) drops!
quick_start: Inspect red H3 hexagons on https://gpsjam.org/ across Baltic, Black Sea, Eastern Med, and Red Sea corridors by date.

name: ImportYeti
description: Free search engine over 100M+ US Customs (CBP Automated Manifest System) sea bills of lading—exposing overseas factory suppliers, US buyers, HS codes, container weights, and shipment frequencies.
quick_start: Search any brand or overseas manufacturer on https://www.importyeti.com/ to map its physical supply chain for free.

name: MarineTraffic
description: Global coastal and satellite AIS ship-tracking standard displaying live vessel positions, reported draught changes, destination strings, port arrivals, and crowdsourced hull photography.
quick_start: Check reported Draught changes before/after an offshore loitering gap to confirm covert cargo offloading!

name: Airframes.io (ACARS / VDL2 Datalink)
description: Aggregates live VHF/HF/Satcom ACARS, VDL2, and HFDL plain-text cockpit datalink messages worldwide—often exposing flight numbers, maintenance faults, and dispatch texts from military/bizjets.
quick_start: Filter by tail number or ICAO hex on https://app.airframes.io/ to read decoded ACARS text dispatches.

name: BIC Container Prefix & Check-Digit Registry
description: Official Bureau International des Containers lookup resolving 4-letter ISO 6346 shipping container owner prefixes (e.g., `MSCU`, `MAEU`, `OOLU`) spotted in port/rail photos or videos.
quick_start: Read the 4-letter container owner code + 7 digits from cargo imagery, verify check-digit, and resolve owner via BIC + Track-Trace.

name: Bidfax / Stat.vin Salvage Auction VIN Archives
description: Indexes millions of historical US/Canadian Copart & IAAI insurance-auction lots by 17-char VIN—preserving 10+ high-res interior/odometer/damage photos of vehicles later exported to Eurasia, MENA, or West Africa!
quick_start: Search any North American 17-digit VIN spotted on a foreign/conflict vehicle on https://en.bidfax.info/ to view its US auction history!

name: FAA Aircraft Registry (N-Number Inquiry)
description: Official US Federal Aviation Administration registry mapping `N-` tail numbers to Mode-S 8-digit octal / 6-char hex codes, airframe serials, registered LLC/bank-trust owners, and downloadable CSV master dumps.
quick_start: When an N-number is held by Wilmington Trust / TVPX Trust, request FAA Aircraft Registration FOIA trust-agreement PDFs!

name: FlightAware
description: Authoritative IFR flight-plan filing, FBO arrival/departure log, and historical route database covering global airlines and North American/European general aviation.
quick_start: Check filed IFR route strings and FBO destination handlers on https://www.flightaware.com/.

name: LiveATC.net
description: Streams live VHF air traffic control tower/approach/center frequencies worldwide and stores 30-day downloadable 30-minute MP3 audio archives keyed by ICAO airport code and UTC block.
quick_start: Pull 30-day ATC MP3 archives at https://www.liveatc.net/archive.php using airport ICAO code + exact UTC half-hour.

name: MyShipTracking
description: Generous free real-time AIS ship map offering multi-day historical vessel tracks, port call logs, speed graphs, and fleet groupings without aggressive paywalls.
quick_start: Check multi-day past track & speed curves on https://www.myshiptracking.com/ when MarineTraffic truncates free history.

name: NHTSA vPIC VIN Decoder & API
description: Official US DOT National Highway Traffic Safety Administration 17-character VIN decoder and completely free keyless REST/JSON API returning make, model, assembly plant, engine, and WMI manufacturer.
quick_start: curl -s 'https://vpic.nhtsa.dot.gov/api/vehicles/decodevinvalues/5YJSA1E26MF123456?format=json' | jq

name: OpenRailwayMap
description: Detailed global rail-infrastructure overlay built on OpenStreetMap showing track gauges, electrification voltages, max speeds, signaling systems, milestones, and industrial spurs—vital for train video geolocation!
quick_start: Switch between Infrastructure, Max Speeds, and Electrification views on https://www.openrailwaymap.org/ when geolocating rail videos.

name: Paris MoU & Tokyo MoU Port State Control Databases
description: Official European (`parismou.org`) and Asia-Pacific (`apcis.tmou.org`) Port State Control inspection databases exposing vessel safety deficiencies, detentions, certificates, and ISM technical managers!
quick_start: Query any IMO number in Paris MoU / Tokyo MoU APCIS to uncover substandard maintenance and certificate issuers.

name: Planespotters.net
description: Global aviation photography and airframe production-list database tracking aircraft MSN serial numbers across every historical airline/government re-registration and paint livery change.
quick_start: Trace an airframe's Manufacturers Serial Number (MSN) on Planespotters to link shell charter operators.

name: S&P Panjiva & ImportGenius
description: Enterprise multi-country customs manifest databases covering US, Latin America (Mexico, Brazil, Colombia, Peru, Chile), India, Vietnam, and Pakistan import/export shipment records.
quick_start: Journalists can apply for investigative access via GIJN/ImportGenius; use ImportYeti first for free US sea manifest coverage.

name: The OpenSky Network
description: Swiss non-profit academic air-traffic sensor network offering free REST APIs and multi-year Trino/Impala SQL access to raw historical Mode-S, ADS-B, and FLARM transponder frames.
quick_start: curl -s 'https://opensky-network.org/api/states/all?lamin=45.8&lomin=5.9&lamax=47.8&lomax=10.5' | jq

name: Track-Trace (Multi-Carrier Container & Air Waybill)
description: Unified multi-carrier tracking portal tracing ISO shipping containers, Bills of Lading, and 3-digit IATA Air Waybills (`AWB`) across dozens of ocean lines and air cargo carriers.
quick_start: Enter a container ID (e.g. `MSCU1234567`) on https://www.track-trace.com/container to trace port-of-loading and vessel Voyages.

name: VesselFinder
description: Fast real-time AIS ship position tracker, port call log, and IMO/MMSI vessel specification lookup with clean unauthenticated search.
quick_start: Cross-check live terrestrial AIS hits between VesselFinder, MarineTraffic, and MyShipTracking.

name: ArcNautical Vessel Sanctions Screen
description: Keyless, accountless IMO vessel sanctions screener cross-checking ships against OFAC, EU, UK, and UN maritime designations with a free JSON endpoint.
quick_start: Screen IMO numbers rapidly and cross-verify positive matches in OpenSanctions and official OFAC SDN.

name: CruiseMapper & Port Webcams
description: Tracks global passenger cruise ships, ferries, and icebreakers in real time—critically indexing live bow/bridge deck webcams that inadvertently capture surrounding naval/port harbor activity!
quick_start: Check which cruise ship was docked in a port on an incident date to pull live harbor weather/visibility from its bridge cam!

name: ITU MARS (Maritime Mobile Access & Retrieval System)
description: Official International Telecommunication Union ship-station radio license database mapping MMSI numbers, radio callsigns, EPIRB hex IDs, and registered ship owners.
quick_start: Resolve unknown MMSI numbers or marine VHF callsigns via ITU MARS.

name: GLEIF Legal Entity Identifier (LEI) Search
description: Global Legal Entity Identifier Foundation database mapping 2.6M+ financial counterparties worldwide—explicitly disclosing 'Level 2' Direct Accounting Parent and Ultimate Parent ownership chains!
quick_start: curl -s 'https://api.gleif.org/api/v1/lei-records?filter[entity.legalName]=Example' | jq

name: ICIJ Offshore Leaks Database
description: Interactive graph database from the International Consortium of Investigative Journalists spanning 810,000+ offshore shell companies, trusts, and foundations from Panama, Pandora, Paradise, and Bahamas Papers.
quick_start: Explore interactive Neo4j officer/intermediary/address graphs on https://offshoreleaks.icij.org/ or download the full CSV graph.

name: OCCRP Aleph
description: Organized Crime and Corruption Reporting Project's flagship investigative data platform cross-indexing hundreds of millions of leaked emails, land registries, gazettes, procurement files, and corporate filings.
quick_start: Search names, passport numbers, IBANs, or company strings across 300+ public datasets on https://aleph.occrp.org/.

name: OpenCorporates
description: World's largest open database of legal entities—normalizing 220M+ company registrations and 290M+ officer/director records across 140+ national and state jurisdictions with direct registry provenance.
quick_start: Switch search tab from 'Companies' to 'Officers' on https://opencorporates.com/ to find every company directed by a person globally!

name: OpenSanctions
description: Open-source entity graph normalizing 1.8M+ sanctioned entities, Politically Exposed Persons (PEPs), shadow-fleet vessels, aircraft, crypto wallets, and criminal warrants across 475+ official global sources.
quick_start: Search free at https://www.opensanctions.org/search/ or self-host `yente` (`docker run -p 8000:8000 ghcr.io/opensanctions/yente:latest`).

name: Pappers.fr (French Corporate & UBO Intelligence)
description: Open French corporate intelligence platform enriching INSEE/INPI/BODACC data—providing free downloadable PDF statutes, annual accounts, director networks, and Registre des Bénéficiaires Effectifs!
quick_start: Search any French company or director name on https://www.pappers.fr/ for free downloadable incorporation PDFs and UBO trees!

name: ProPublica Nonprofit Explorer
description: Full-text search over 14M+ IRS Form 990 tax filings from US 501(c) tax-exempt organizations, foundations, think tanks, and trade associations—exposing executive pay, Schedule I grants, and board members.
quick_start: Search Schedule I & Schedule J inside Form 990 XML/PDFs on ProPublica to trace dark-money foundation grants and contractor fees.

name: SEC EDGAR Full-Text Search
description: US Securities and Exchange Commission full-text search across every 10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, Form 4 insider trade, 13F fund portfolio, and Exhibit 21 subsidiary list filed since 2001.
quick_start: Use https://www.sec.gov/edgar/search/ (`EFTS`) to search Exhibit 21 (`EX-21`) for complete global subsidiary trees of public companies!

name: UK Companies House & Overseas Entities Register
description: Gold-standard completely free corporate registry providing full PDF incorporation deeds, annual accounts, officer DOBs/addresses, Persons with Significant Control (PSC), and Overseas Entities owning UK property!
quick_start: Always inspect the 'People -> Persons with significant control' tab and 'Register of Overseas Entities' filings!

name: US Treasury OFAC Sanctions List Search
description: Authoritative US Treasury Office of Foreign Assets Control fuzzy-matching lookup covering SDN and Consolidated Non-SDN lists—including sanctioned passport IDs, IMO numbers, tail numbers, and BTC/ETH/USDT addresses.
quick_start: Set Minimum Name Score slider to 85 on https://sanctionssearch.ofac.treas.gov/ or search digital currency addresses in the ID field.

name: Violation Tracker & Subsidy Tracker (Good Jobs First)
description: Searchable database cataloging corporate regulatory fines, environmental penalties, FCPA bribery settlements, labor violations, and antitrust actions across 40+ countries ($1T+ in tracked penalties!).
